title: 2004 AMC 12B Problem 6
statement: Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is \(8\) miles southwest of downtown St. Paul and \(10\) miles southeast of downtown Minneapolis. Which of the following is closest to the number of miles between downtown St. Paul and downtown Minneapolis?

solutions.text:
Southwest and southeast are perpendicular, so the airport sits at the right angle of a right triangle with legs \(8\) and \(10.\) The distance between downtowns is \(\sqrt{10^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{164} \approx 12.8,\) closest to \(13.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Southwest and southeast directions are perpendicular
